name: Juicy Broiled Burgers

instructions.primary_message: Preheat broiler and adjust oven rack to about 15 cm from heat source. Place a wire rack on a foil-lined baking sheet. Divide meat into four equal 170 g portions and gently shape each one into a patty 11-cm wide by approximately 1.5-cm thick. Place on a flat surface and create a dimple in the center of the patty by pushing down with three or four fingers. The dimple should be about 1/4 of an inch deep and 8 cm across. Season generously with salt and pepper.

Place patties on prepared baking sheet. Broil in preheated oven for 3 minutes until top is well-browned. Flip patties and continue to broil until center reads 54°C (130°F) on an instant-read thermometer for medium-rare, about 3 minutes longer. Adjust cooking time if you want them more or less cooked.
Top each patty with a slice of cheese, place back under broiler for 25 seconds to melt, place on buns, top as desired, and serve.

description: There's no need to fire up the grill when you need a satisfying burger fix. Here's the secret to thick, juicy broiled burgers.
notes: Optional or for serving: Toppings and condiments as desired
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
